To calculate overlaps, remember that the Manders calculation provides a comparison in both directions: channel A in B (M1) or channel B in A (M2), so depending on what you want to look at, you need to ensure the right M column is chosen to be plotted. So, keep in mind which channel is which fluorescent protein, and which direction you are measuring to get the correct M column (and make sure you use the thresholded.M!)

JMC306
pgl/znfx overlap
```{r}
strain_labs=c("L4440","C27B7.5","D2005.4","F13D12.5","F46F11.1","M01H9.3","Y110A7A.15","Y111B2A.3","Y39A3CL.4", "F56C9.6","Y66D12A.19","W05F2.6")

# Filter rows based on conditions and extract Strain
C1C3_df <- combined_df %>%
  filter(grepl("^C1", Image.A) & grepl("^C3", Image.B)) %>%
  mutate(Strain = case_when(
    grepl("L4440", Image.A) ~ "L4440",
    grepl("C27", Image.A)   ~ "C27B7.5",
    grepl("D", Image.A)     ~ "D2005.4",
    grepl("F13", Image.A)   ~ "F13D12.5",
    grepl("F46", Image.A)   ~ "F46F11.1",
    grepl("M01", Image.A)   ~ "M01H9.3",
    grepl("Y110", Image.A)  ~ "Y110A7A.15",
    grepl("Y111", Image.A)  ~ "Y111B2A.3",
    grepl("Y39", Image.A)   ~ "Y39A3CL.4",
    grepl("F56", Image.A)   ~ "F56C9.6",
    grepl("Y66", Image.A)   ~ "Y66D12A.19",
    grepl("W05", Image.A)   ~ "W05F2.6",
    TRUE                    ~ NA_character_
  ))

M1 <- C1C3_df[,c(13,20)]
M1$version<-"PGL-1 in ZNFX-1"
names(M1)[names(M1)=="Thresholded.M1"]<- 'Manders'
M2 <- C1C3_df[,c(14,20)]
M2$version<-"ZNFX-1 in PGL-1"
names(M2)[names(M2)=="Thresholded.M2"]<- 'Manders'

C1C3_simp <- rbind(M1,M2)

C1C3_simp$Strain <- factor(C1C3_simp$Strain, levels=c("L4440","C27B7.5","D2005.4","F13D12.5","F46F11.1","M01H9.3","Y110A7A.15","Y111B2A.3","Y39A3CL.4", "F56C9.6","Y66D12A.19","W05F2.6"))

stat.test <- C1C3_simp %>%
  group_by(version) %>%
  t_test(Manders ~ Strain, ref.group = "L4440") %>%
  mutate(p.signif = case_when(
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x="Strain", group="version")

dodge <- position_dodge(0.6)

# Plot with modified x-axis variable
ggplot(C1C3_simp, aes(x = Strain, y = Manders, fill=version)) + 
  geom_dotplot(
  binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", color=NA, alpha=0.5, position = dodge
  ) + 
  #ylim(0,2) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        aspect.ratio = 0.35,
        legend.title=element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "pgl-1 znfx-1 overlap",
       x = "RNAi strain",
       y = "Manders") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = names(strain_labs),  # ensures no gaps at edges
  labels = strain_labs,
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))  # tight padding, adjust 0.05 if needed
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#65A2B8","#EB5827")) +
  stat_summary(
   fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult=1), 
    geom = "errorbar", color="black", width=0.25, position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
   fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult=1), 
    geom = "tile", width =0.5, height=0.02, position = position_dodge(0.6)
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test, 
    label = "p.signif", 
    hide.ns = TRUE, 
    remove.bracket = TRUE,
    step.group.by = "version",
    y.position = max(C1C3_simp$Manders) + 0.05  # Set a position for p-values on top of the data
  )
ggsave(file=paste0(directory,"\\Whole_RNAi_C1C3_coloc_withstats_09302026.svg"))

```

meas_directory <- "C:/Users/Samantha/Claycomb Lab Dropbox/Claycomb Lab Team Folder/Sebastian Fuentes/Grad School/Reasearch Project/Images/gg_Imaging/Compiled Data//"

```{r}
# grans is a way to type the gene/protein name without the hyphen
grans <- c("pgl1", "znfx1")
# how the genes were labelled in the txt files with the measurement info (we used a hyphen)
gran_list <- c("pgl-1", "znfx-1")

# named vector: names = how strains appear in the data, values = axis labels
strain_labs <- c(L4440 = "Empty Vector", C27 = "C27B7.5", D = "D2005.4",
                 F13 = "F13D12.5", F46 = "F46F11.1", F56 = "F56C9.6",
                 M01 = "M01H9.3", W05 = "W05F2.6", Y110 = "Y110A7A.15",
                 Y111 = "Y111B2A.3", Y39 = "Y39A3CL.4", Y66 = "Y66D12A.19")
strains <- names(strain_labs)

# ---- helper: t-tests vs L4440 + plot + save ----
plot_vs_L4440 <- function(df, xvar, yvar, title, ylab, outfile) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  # only keep strain levels that actually have data, in the order we want
  df[[xvar]] <- factor(df[[xvar]], levels = intersect(strains, unique(df[[xvar]])))

  # stats: each RNAi strain vs L4440
  stat.test <- df %>%
    t_test(reformulate(xvar, response = yvar), ref.group = "L4440") %>%
    mutate(p.signif = case_when(
      p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE       ~ "ns"
    ))

  # check what's significant in the console
  print(title)
  print(stat.test[, c("group1", "group2", "p", "p.adj", "p.signif")])

  # keep only significant comparisons for plotting
  stat.sig <- stat.test %>% filter(p.signif != "ns")

  # tile height and label position scale with the data range
  y_range <- diff(range(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE))
  tile_h  <- 0.02 * y_range
  label_y <- max(df[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 * y_range

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]], fill = .data[[xvar]])) +
    geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
    #ylim(0,1) +
    theme_classic(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          aspect.ratio = 0.35) +
    labs(title = title, x = "RNAi strain", y = ylab) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    # R likes to go in alpha order, but we want it in this order
    scale_x_discrete(limits = strains, labels = strain_labs,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colours) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1),
                 geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.25) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1),
                 geom = "tile", width = 0.5, height = tile_h) +
    { if (nrow(stat.sig) > 0)
        stat_pvalue_manual(stat.sig,
                           label = "p.signif",
                           x = "group2",
                           y.position = label_y,
                           remove.bracket = TRUE,
                           inherit.aes = FALSE)
    } +
    guides(fill = "none")

  ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p)
  invisible(list(plot = p, stats = stat.test))
}

# ---- loop time! ----
for (g in seq_along(grans)) {

  # List all files containing for example "pgl-1" in their name
  meas_file_list <- list.files(meas_directory, pattern = gran_list[g], full.names = TRUE)
  meas_list <- list()

  for (file in meas_file_list) {
    # Extract the prefix after "Compiled Data\\" and before the first underscore
    prefix  <- sub(".*Compiled Data[\\\\/]+([^_/]+)_.*", "\\1", file)
    # Extract the Worm number after "_Worm" and before the next underscore
    worm    <- sub(".*_Worm(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", file)
    # Extract the Nucleus number after "_n" and before the next underscore
    nucleus <- sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", file)

    df <- fread(file, sep = "\t")
    df[, c("strain", "worm", "nucleus") := list(prefix, worm, nucleus)]
    meas_list[[length(meas_list) + 1]] <- df
  }

  # Combine all dataframes into one and drop tiny objects
  ind_combined_df <- rbindlist(meas_list)
  sized_df <- ind_combined_df[Area >= 0.1]

  # ---- granule size plot ----
  size_res <- plot_vs_L4440(
    sized_df, xvar = "strain", yvar = "Area",
    title = paste(gran_list[g], "granule size"), ylab = "area",
    outfile = file.path(meas_directory_save, "plots",
                        paste0("RNAi_", gran_list[g], "_gransize_09302026.svg"))
  )

  # ---- count granules per nucleus per worm per strain ----
  count_df <- data.frame(Strain = character(), Worm = integer(),
                         Nucleus = integer(), Count = integer(),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (strain in strains) {
    for (w in 1:3) {
      for (n in 1:3) {
        count <- sum(sized_df$strain == strain & sized_df$worm == w & sized_df$nucleus == n)
        count_df <- rbind(count_df, data.frame(Strain = strain, Worm = w,
                                               Nucleus = n, Count = count))
      }
    }
  }

  # ---- granule count plot ----
  count_res <- plot_vs_L4440(
    count_df, xvar = "Strain", yvar = "Count",
    title = paste(gran_list[g], "granule count"), ylab = "count",
    outfile = file.path(meas_directory_save, "plots",
                        paste0("RNAi_", gran_list[g], "_grancount_09302026.svg"))
  )
}

```
